suites.title: Eve Vakh - Chat & Messaging Comprehensive Test Suite

specs.title: TC_CHAT_001: should validate chat page UI layout, navigation and conversation stream
TC_CHAT_002: should initiate 1-on-1 direct chat and deliver text message to allowed user
TC_CHAT_003: should create or utilize existing group chat with multiple allowed peers
TC_CHAT_004: should allow group admin/owner to edit and save group chat name
TC_CHAT_005: should add allowed member to an existing group chat
TC_CHAT_006: should promote eligible member to group admin role
TC_CHAT_007: should demote admin back to regular member
TC_CHAT_008: should allow group admin to remove member from group
TC_CHAT_009: should open attachment drawer and select photo attachment
TC_CHAT_010: should open attachment drawer and select document file attachment
TC_CHAT_011: should allow user to leave group conversation
TC_CHAT_012: [Negative] should disable send button for empty or whitespace-only messages
TC_CHAT_013: [Negative] should protect group creator from removal by other admins
TC_CHAT_014: [Negative] should restrict regular members from removing admin users
TC_CHAT_015: [Negative] should enforce that only accepted members can be promoted to admin
TC_CHAT_016: [Edge] should successfully send rich text with emojis and multi-line linebreaks
TC_CHAT_017: when User A is blocked by User B, User A cannot see online status, typing indicator, or updated profile picture in existing conversation history
TC_CHAT_018: blocked user cannot be added to a group chat created by the blocker, and a clear error prompt explains the user cannot be added
TC_CHAT_019: network disconnect during media/file upload stops progress, displays retry option, and prevents app freeze
TC_CHAT_020: sending messages while offline marks messages as Pending/Queued and automatically dispatches upon network restoration
TC_CHAT_021: unblocked user immediately restores real-time messaging capabilities without requiring app reload
TC_CHAT_022: attempting to create a group chat without selecting any members or with an empty group name is prevented
TC_CHAT_023: submitting an empty chat message (or message consisting solely of spaces, tabs, or newline characters) is blocked and the send button remains disabled
TC_CHAT_024: uploading files exceeding the maximum file size limit (e.g., >50MB or >100MB) immediately aborts with a File exceeds maximum allowed size toast
TC_CHAT_025: when a group chat is muted, @mention notifications either respect the mute setting or alert based on user preference settings
TC_CHAT_026: uploading unsupported file formats (.exe, .bat, .sh, .dmg, .dll, zero-byte empty files) in chat shows an Unsupported file format error and rejects the upload
TC_CHAT_027: sending messages with right-to-left (RTL) text (Arabic, Hebrew) mixed with LTR text, verifying bidirectional text isolation and layout stability
TC_CHAT_028: typing indicators: verify typing status disappears after 5 seconds of inactivity or if the user abruptly disconnects or closes the browser tab
TC_CHAT_029: concurrent messaging in group chats: when 10+ users send messages simultaneously, all messages are delivered in consistent chronological timestamp order
TC_CHAT_030: mutually blocked users in same existing group chat: verify message visibility and interaction restrictions inside shared group
TC_CHAT_031: sending messages containing raw HTML/script tags renders safely as plain text without HTML injection
TC_CHAT_032: message flood and spam protection: rapidly sending 20+ messages within 5 seconds triggers rate-limit delay with slow down indicator
TC_CHAT_033: group chat member limit: attempting to add members beyond maximum group size capacity displays Group limit reached notification
